title: Iran urges US to accept proposal to reopen Strait of Hormuz
gist: Iran's foreign minister says Tehran's seven-day proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz remains on the table, conditional on US lifting its port blockade and oil sanctions and ending regional hostilities. The US insists on addressing Iran's nuclear programme up front, leaving talks stalled in an eight-month war.

insights.claim: Iran says its proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days is still on the table, and the strait could reopen within six days of US acceptance, with talks resuming the next day.
insights.so_what: A concrete timeline suggests a rapid supply restoration if a deal happens; a binary risk for oil and LNG.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor

insights.claim: Iran's conditions include lifting the US blockade of its ports, lifting US sanctions on its oil exports, and ending hostilities on all regional fronts.
insights.so_what: Sanctions relief on Iranian oil is part of the price, relevant to longer-run supply expectations.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor

insights.claim: Iran presented the proposal in mid-September after an interim ceasefire collapsed, and its security chief said talks stalled because Washington did not address all seven conditions.
insights.so_what: Negotiations are stalled, so Hormuz disruption likely persists.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor

insights.claim: The central disagreement is US insistence on addressing Iran's nuclear programme from the outset, while Tehran wants talks first to focus on reopening Hormuz and restoring security.
insights.so_what: Sequencing, not just substance, blocks a deal; watch for a phased framework.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor

insights.claim: Vice President JD Vance said Iran must make a 'meaningful' reduction in uranium enrichment capacity to end the eight-month war.
insights.so_what: Defines a US threshold for a deal.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor

insights.claim: Before the war the Strait of Hormuz carried about a fifth of global trade in oil and LNG.
insights.so_what: Explains the scale of the market impact of closure.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
